title: 玩家操作无效或响应缺失
description: 玩家输入或选择对游戏结果没有影响，角色或NPC不响应指令，自动任务系统无法有效执行玩家意图。
evidence: Removal of the ability to access things on the floor through the inventory has essentially killed this for me, it makes so many simple things a thousand times harder for no real reason.
the NPC just stood on their bridge for 5 minutes doing nothing

evidence_items.quote: некоторые действия персонажей просто перестают работать
evidence_items.description: 某些角色动作不再响应
evidence_items.quote_zh: 而角色的一些操作干脆就不再起作用了

evidence_items.quote: Autotasking, which is basically required if you don't want to click your character through installing 400 floors and 80 walls one by one, is very bad in a lot of ways
evidence_items.description: 自动任务系统很差，无法有效指挥角色完成建造
evidence_items.quote_zh: 自动任务分配，如果你不想一个接一个地点击你的角色来安装400块地板和80面墙，基本上是必需的，但它在很多方面都非常糟糕

evidence_items.description: 社交对话中的选择对结果没有任何影响

evidence_items.quote: the NPC just stood on their bridge for 5 minutes doing nothing
evidence_items.description: NPC在舰桥站立5分钟无反应，玩家操作无效
evidence_items.quote_zh: 那个NPC就站在他们的舰桥上5分钟什么也没做

evidence_items.quote: Removal of the ability to access things on the floor through the inventory has essentially killed this for me, it makes so many simple things a thousand times harder for no real reason.
evidence_items.description: 移除通过物品栏访问地面物品的能力，使简单操作变得极其困难
evidence_items.quote_zh: 移除了通过物品栏访问地板上物品的能力，这基本上彻底毁了我对这个游戏的兴趣，它让许多简单的事情变得难上一千倍，而且毫无真正的理由。
